description: Frontend scaffolding in /home/andrefontoura/PhpstormProjects/sisbrasfute_tailwind: a backward-compatible labelName prop on ModalitiesSelect, the src/router/court.js owner routes + registration in index.js, the admin-courts route in admin.js, and the 'Quadras' nav group + admin approval nav entry in systemLayout.vue. This wires navigation/routing before the screens exist; routes point at Court SFCs that FEAT-004 creates, so to keep the build green this FEAT also creates minimal placeholder SFCs that FEAT-004 replaces. Depends on FEAT-002 for the API contract (shapes only; no runtime dependency to build).
steps: Edit /home/andrefontoura/PhpstormProjects/sisbrasfute_tailwind/src/components/form/ModalitiesSelect.vue: add a prop labelName { type: String, default: 'Modalidades que joga' } and bind the <label> text (and the aria-label) to it instead of the hardcoded string. This is backward compatible — existing callers that omit it keep the current label.

Create /home/andrefontoura/PhpstormProjects/sisbrasfute_tailwind/src/router/court.js exporting an array of OWNER routes (lazy imports, meta { requiresAuth: true }): { path:'/courts/my-courts', name:'my-courts', component: () => import('../views/System/Court/MyCourts.vue') }, { path:'/courts/form', name:'court-form', component: () => import('../views/System/Court/CourtForm.vue') }, { path:'/courts/edit/:id', name:'court-edit', component: () => import('../views/System/Court/CourtForm.vue') }, { path:'/courts/show/:id', name:'court-show', component: () => import('../views/System/Court/CourtShow.vue') }.

Edit /home/andrefontoura/PhpstormProjects/sisbrasfute_tailwind/src/router/index.js: add `import court from './court.js'` with the other route imports and add `...court` to the routes array (next to `...team`).

Edit /home/andrefontoura/PhpstormProjects/sisbrasfute_tailwind/src/router/admin.js: add { path:'/admin/courts', name:'admin-courts', component: () => import('../views/System/Admin/AdminCourtList.vue'), meta: { requiresAuth: true, requiresAdmin: true } } (admin routes all live in admin.js — do NOT put this in court.js).

Edit /home/andrefontoura/PhpstormProjects/sisbrasfute_tailwind/src/components/layouts/systemLayout.vue: add BuildingOffice2Icon to the existing `@heroicons/vue/20/solid` import block AND to the components registration object (confirmed present in that icon set). In data() navigation[] add a group { name:'Quadras', icon: BuildingOffice2Icon, current:false, children:[ { name:'Minhas Quadras', href:'/courts/my-courts' }, { name:'Cadastrar Quadra', href:'/courts/form' } ] } (shown to all authenticated users — do not role-gate). In adminChildren[] add { name:'Quadras (Aprovação)', href:'/admin/courts' }.

Create minimal placeholder SFCs so the lazy route imports resolve and `npm run build` stays green (FEAT-004 replaces each with the full implementation): /home/andrefontoura/PhpstormProjects/sisbrasfute_tailwind/src/views/System/Court/MyCourts.vue, CourtForm.vue, CourtShow.vue, and /home/andrefontoura/PhpstormProjects/sisbrasfute_tailwind/src/views/System/Admin/AdminCourtList.vue. Each placeholder wraps a short 'Em breve' message in <system-layout> (import systemLayout from '@/components/layouts/systemLayout.vue'), Options API, so it compiles cleanly.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` succeeds (all SFC imports resolve, no template/compile errors).
ModalitiesSelect still renders its default label when labelName is not passed (existing TeamForm unaffected) and shows a custom label when passed.
Navigating to /courts/my-courts, /courts/form, /courts/edit/:id, /courts/show/:id and /admin/courts resolves a component.
The sidebar shows a 'Quadras' group for authenticated users and a 'Quadras (Aprovação)' admin entry.
verification: Run `npm run build` from /home/andrefontoura/PhpstormProjects/sisbrasfute_tailwind and confirm it completes without errors.
Optionally run `npm run lint` and confirm no new errors.
